name: Eri Shinjou
source:
An experienced fighter that joined the school as a battle instructor. She has a fiancée.

In battle she is a sword dancer. She has a skill that cuts enemy HP in half, even for bosses.

NOTE: She was added in the expansion Custom Reido 4+.
